dedupe_keys.name: conus balancing authority generation and monthly plant inventory

description: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory publishes simulated wind and solar generation that follows changes in installed plant capacity and balancing-authority membership. The archive contains hourly plant and balancing-authority series plus a monthly inventory for 2007–2020. It applies capacity histories assembled from EIA reports to modelled generation profiles. Public CSV files are packaged on Zenodo and are free under CC0. The data can validate aggregation and resource-adequacy simulations in model-pypsa, complementing the fixed-fleet data-eia-2020-plant-wind-solar-hourly-profiles. A caveat is that these are simulated historical outputs, not meter observations. The provider documents corrections to selected wind plants with capacity factors above one and a revised annual-report inventory basis. Retirement, maintenance and authority membership need consistent interpretation. No archived series were downloaded or independently validated.
